note: The English bio carries no Book C:V citations (0 in en, 0 in uk) and quotes no verse with a reference; its quotations are Calvin's own words (motto, Psalms-commentary preface, a lecture prayer, the 1549 letter to Viret) and Knox's phrase, all translated.

Calvin's last words, the psalmist's «How long, O Lord» (Psalm 13:1, as the es/ar/sw/lg editions record it), are rendered «Доки, Господи» in the closing <h2> and final paragraph — Kulish opens Psalm 13 with «Доки Господи»; the comma is modern punctuation, so the row is self_rendered, not mined.
